title: Settings carry a key absent from the element's props schema ('meta_description') → ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID (settings-key truthfulness gate)
_comment: TRUTHFULNESS-GATE fixture (false-valid #3, 1.7.x settings-key gate). Core's Props_Parser::validate() iterates SCHEMA keys only, so an unknown settings key is SILENTLY STRIPPED while parse() still reports valid — the key vanishes at save with no error (field incident: meta descriptions). The companion gate derives the allowlist from get_props_schema() (which injects core-accepted keys like _cssid) and hard-errors on anything else, mirroring the style-prop gate. VERIFIED valid:false {ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID} via the companion dry_run REST route on Elementor 4.2.1 free (playground :8947, 2026-08-12). prefilter.verdict:defer — schema-key membership is a PHP-authority decision (the TS prefilter has no per-element schema).

meta_description.value: this key does not exist in the schema
